g1.label: 1. The scientist said the reef ___ in danger
g1.why: After a past reporting verb, present “is” shifts back to “was”.

g2.label: 2. …they ___ healthy coral
g2.why: Present progressive “are growing” backshifts to past progressive “were growing”.

g4.label: 4. …he ___ so much bleaching before
g4.why: Present perfect “has never seen” backshifts to past perfect “had never seen”.

g5.label: 5. …climate change ___ the biggest threat
g5.why: “Is” backshifts to “was” after the past reporting verb “reported”.

g6.label: 6. …tourists ___ touch the coral
g6.why: “Must not” has no past form, so reported speech uses “were not allowed to”.

g8.label: 8. …the reef ___ half its coral since 1985
g8.why: Present perfect “has lost” backshifts to past perfect “had lost”.
